info.title: Elder Engagement REST API
info.summary: Controlled Sprint 3 contract draft for Android, iOS, Contributor and Administrator clients
info.description: This draft covers the verified Week 2 foundation plus the Sprint 3 notification-preference, predefined-circle, private Contributor-upload, Administrator moderation, circle-filtered Member-feed and basic event interfaces. It contains no production hostname, credential or personal data.

x-implementation-status: Contract-only draft. No listed operation is claimed callable until the matching backend commit is deployed and its smoke-test evidence is recorded.

x-client-error-actions.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Attempt one serialized refresh; if refresh fails, return to sign-in.
x-client-error-actions.INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN: Delete local tokens and return to sign-in without retrying the same token.
x-client-error-actions.REFRESH_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Do not retry the same refresh token. Delete local tokens and return to sign-in because this draft defines no safe session-status recovery operation.
x-client-error-actions.SESSION_REVOKED: Delete local tokens and return to sign-in.
x-client-error-actions.REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED: Delete all local tokens and return to sign-in because the token family is revoked.
x-client-error-actions.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: Delete local tokens, stop protected requests and show the client-approved support route.
x-client-error-actions.MFA_REQUIRED: Prompt the authorised staff user for the configured second factor and retry once.
x-client-error-actions.RATE_LIMITED: Wait for the Retry-After duration before retrying.
x-client-error-actions.CIRCLE_LIMIT_REACHED: Explain the current membership limit and let the Member leave another circle before trying again.
x-client-error-actions.UPLOAD_MISMATCH: Do not retry completion. Ask the Contributor to select the correct file and start a new upload.
x-client-error-actions.INVALID_CURSOR: Discard the saved cursor and reload the first feed page.

servers.description: Local development only; client-owned staging origin is pending

get.summary: Confirm that the process is running
Confirm that required dependencies are ready

post.summary: Exchange a verified phone-identity token for a platform session
post.description: The Android or iOS client completes phone one-time-password verification with the client-approved Firebase Authentication or Identity Platform project, then submits the resulting provider token. The backend accepts only the configured issuer and audience, requires a provider-verified phone identity, and resolves the Member role itself. The backend does not accept or log the one-time password. A verified new phone identity creates one active Member account atomically and receives a session immediately. The response uses profileComplete=false until the Member creates their profile. Contributors cannot be created through this operation.

post.summary: Create a Contributor or Administrator session
post.description: The backend resolves Contributor or Administrator role from the stored account and never trusts a role supplied by the client. Contributors use Administrator-created usernames and passwords. Administrators require a password plus a verified authenticator-app code; enrollment and verification remain pending implementation. The validated staff endpoint is a disabled-by-default interface candidate, not deployed or accepting real credentials yet. Without a real staff adapter it returns DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE and never issues tokens.

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token and issue a new access token
post.description: Mobile clients must serialize refresh so only one request uses a token at a time. A successful response replaces both stored tokens atomically and retains the same user identifier. Member renewal preserves the original session-family expiry (configured as 30 days by default), rather than extending it on each renewal. Reuse of a replaced refresh token revokes its whole family. Suspended, deleted, revoked or expired sessions cannot renew. After an uncertain network outcome or a 503 response, do not retry the same refresh token: clear local tokens and return to sign-in because this draft defines no safe recovery/status operation. This implementation step supports Members only; staff support remains dependent on EE-010, and deployment verification is required before treating it as callable.

200.description: Credentials replaced within the existing token family

post.description: Member session controls verify the platform access token and current account/session state. Successful logout revokes the token family. Later use of the removed session is rejected; a repeated logout is unauthorised. Staff support remains pending implementation.

204.description: Session revoked; response has no body

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's detailed profile

patch.summary: Create or update the authenticated user's permitted profile fields
patch.description: For a newly verified Member with profileComplete=false, the first valid request creates the profile. Later requests update only fields the authenticated user is permitted to change.

post.summary: Create a short-lived profile-photo upload authorisation
Validate the uploaded object and attach it to the profile
Create a short-lived private content-upload authorisation
post.description: Contributor only. The Contributor must confirm ownership or permission before Amiko creates a draft item and a private upload authorisation. The file remains outside the approved-content area.

post.summary: Validate a private upload and place it in the Administrator review queue
post.description: Checks the stored object's exact content type, size, SHA-256 fingerprint and file signature. The signed upload is create-only, so a verified object cannot be replaced through the same link. Success records a quarantined asset with pending scan and moderation status; it does not publish or move the file to approved storage.

200.description: Upload validated and waiting for Administrator review

get.summary: List private Contributor content waiting for review
get.description: Administrator only. Returns at most 100 pending items and metadata; it does not expose a permanent file address.

get.summary: Create a short-lived private preview for one pending item

post.summary: Approve or reject one pending item with a controlled reason
post.description: Administrator only. The decision is final and audited. Approval does not publish the item; audience selection and publication belong to EE-020.

post.summary: Publish an approved item to all Members or selected circles
post.description: Administrator only. The item must be approved, unpublished and backed by a clean reviewed file. Publication moves the file from quarantine to private approved storage and records the selected audience atomically.

200.description: Content published to its controlled audience

get.summary: List approved content visible to the signed-in Member
get.description: Member only. Every page rechecks current active-circle membership. Unapproved, unpublished and quarantined items are excluded.

get.summary: Create a short-lived private link for one visible feed item
get.description: Member only. Circle visibility is rechecked before issuing the five-minute media link. The link is sensitive and must not be logged or retained.

post.description: Administrator only. The event is information-only in EE-021; Google Meet and telephone joining are separate later integrations. Audience circles must be active. Reminder timings are recorded but delivery is handled separately.

get.summary: List events visible to the signed-in Member
get.description: Member only. Every page rechecks current active-circle membership. Upcoming events are oldest-first and past events are newest-first.

get.summary: Get my notification choices and delivery window
get.description: Returns only the authenticated account's choices. A missing saved row returns safe defaults without writing data.

put.summary: Replace my complete notification choices and delivery window
put.description: A complete replacement avoids ambiguous partial updates. The authenticated account can change only its own preferences.

get.summary: List active and joined circles with recommendations
get.description: Returns active predefined circles plus any inactive circle the authenticated Member still belongs to. suggested is calculated from the Member's saved interests and preferred language. Membership information is never returned for another Member.

post.description: The authenticated Member joins immediately. Repeating a completed join is safe. The Administrator-configured active-membership limit starts at five.

204.description: Membership is active; response has no body

delete.description: Closes the authenticated Member's active membership while retaining its history. Repeating a completed leave is safe.

204.description: Membership is inactive; response has no body

get.description: Administrator-only list that includes inactive circles so they can be reviewed or reactivated.

patch.summary: Update, deactivate or reactivate a circle

post.summary: Assign an active Member to an active circle

204.description: Membership is active; response has no body

delete.summary: Remove a Member from a circle

204.description: Membership is inactive; response has no body

put.description: Administrator-only complete replacement. The accepted range is one to twenty and the initial value is five.

get.summary: List active sessions for the authenticated account
get.description: Return only the authenticated Member's unexpired, unrevoked, unreplaced sessions, without token values or hashes. Current account state is checked on every request. Staff support remains pending implementation.

delete.description: An authenticated Member can revoke only their own active target session and its token family. Missing, inactive and other users' targets have the same not-found response. Staff support remains pending implementation.

204.description: Session revoked; response has no body

post.summary: Manually create a detailed user profile
post.description: Supports the client's manual profile-creation requirement. Final mandatory fields remain subject to the approved profile-field decision.

patch.description: Requires a current Administrator session. Suspension revokes saved sessions; reactivation requires a new sign-in. Invitations use separate credential activation. The last usable active Administrator cannot be suspended. Updates and their audit commit together.

patch.summary: Change a user role with an audit reason
patch.description: Requires a current Administrator session. Role changes revoke saved sessions. Member-to-Contributor creates invited status until credential activation. Administrator promotion requires a confirmed authenticator. Staff-to-Member requires existing Google phone identity. The last usable active Administrator cannot be demoted. Mutations and audit commit together.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user is not permitted to perform the operation

NotFound.description: The resource is unavailable to the caller

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current resource or session state

RateLimited.description: Request rate exceeded; Retry-After is expressed in seconds

PayloadTooLarge.description: The received request body exceeds the configured maximum

MethodNotAllowed.description: The HTTP method is not supported for this resource

InternalError.description: An unexpected internal error occurred; sensitive details are not returned

accessToken.description: Sensitive response value. Store only in operating-system protected storage and never log it.

refreshToken.description: Sensitive rotating response value. Store only in operating-system protected storage and never log it.

profileComplete.description: False directs the client to the self-service profile setup journey without blocking access.

NotificationWindow.description: If enabled is true, both local times are required. A start later than the end represents a window crossing midnight. The server validates timeZone against its supported IANA time-zone database. If enabled is false, both times must be null or omitted.

NotificationPreferencesUpdate.description: Complete replacement of an account's notification choices. deliveryWindow.enabled=false allows delivery at any local time. A window whose start is later than its end crosses midnight.

ProfileUpdate.description: This is a documented partial-update object carried as application/json, not JSON Merge Patch. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Explicit null clears only fields whose schema permits null. Arrays replace the complete previous array. notificationWindow replaces the complete nested object and must therefore contain enabled and timeZone plus both local times when enabled.

AdminCreateUserRequest.description: Manual onboarding follows role-specific identity rules. A Member requires a non-null phone number matching the later verified provider identity and cannot use a username. A Contributor or Administrator requires a non-null username; an optional phone may also be recorded. Staff accounts are created with invited status and cannot authenticate until the separate EE-010 credential-activation flow is implemented and completed.

uploadUrl.description: Sensitive short-lived value that must not be logged.

sizeBytes.description: Maximum 250 MiB for MP4 video, 50 MiB for MP3/M4A audio and 25 MiB for PDF.

rightsConfirmed.description: Confirms that the Contributor owns the material or has permission to upload it.

uploadUrl.description: Sensitive short-lived value that must not be logged or stored after use.

previewUrl.description: Sensitive short-lived private value that must not be logged or retained.

mediaUrl.description: Sensitive five-minute private value that must not be logged or retained.

startsAt.description: Must include an offset and be in the future.

endsAt.description: When supplied, must be after startsAt.

joinKind.description: EE-021 does not yet provide Google Meet or telephone joining.
